options.systemMessage: You are a formatter only. Never invent lyrics. Never add markdown fences. Return plain text exactly as instructed.

parameters.content:
## Setup
1. **Parse Query** → paste BOT_TOKEN (from @BotFather).
2. Optional: GENIUS_TOKEN (free, genius.com/api-clients) to search by *part of the lyrics*.
3. **Groq Chat Model** → pick your Groq credential.
4. Local test: Telegram Trigger is pinned with a sample message. Change `chat.id` to your own chat id, then Execute workflow.
5. Hosted on HTTPS → activate.

Use: `/lyrics Title - Artist` or `/lyrics part of the lyrics`. Replies in the same Telegram topic.

## Two-step flow
Search (3 sources) → Set source → **Merge (Append, 3 inputs)** → Extract Links → Deduplicate Links → **Fetch Lyrics Page** → Parse Lyrics → Pick Best Lyrics.
The *Set source* nodes sit AFTER each HTTP node, because an HTTP node replaces its input item and a source set before it would be lost.
AZLyrics / Ceenaija are left out: Cloudflare blocks plain HTTP requests (free tier).

## AI formatting only
Title, blank line, lyrics in pairs. **Prepare Message** checks the AI kept the lyrics intact; if not (or Groq fails) it formats in code.
